description: 24-prompt seller support hard-eval dataset: 12 support categories × 2 cases (medium/hard difficulty). Derived from the dataset-brainstorm-v3 seed bank, covering ODR recovery, suspensions, fee disputes, counterfeit and IP appeals.
source: dataset-brainstorm-v3 seed bank — hard-eval coverage derived from DATASET_STRATEGY.md taxonomy
